scripts.services:install: npm --prefix services/backend install && npm --prefix services/frontend install
scripts.services:build: npm --prefix services/backend run build && npm --prefix services/frontend run build
scripts.services:lint: npm --prefix services/backend run lint && npm --prefix services/frontend run lint
scripts.services:test: npm --prefix services/backend test && npm --prefix services/frontend test
scripts.services:first-run: npm run services:db:up && npm --prefix services/backend run create:root
